semantics.fisher: accepted-example-weighted global empirical Fisher; zero valid samples preserve prior anchors
semantics.reduction: FP64 prescaled bounded buckets, stored in FP32/FP64 masters
semantics.teacher: unwrapped frozen supplied policy, with buffer-broadcast preference honored once
semantics.staged_state: private replay/RNG and task memory commit only after peer validation
semantics.preserved_state: pending policy/entropy banks, optimizer, policy, local buffers, module modes and global RNG during direct consolidation
semantics.task_windows: flush prior-task pending update before capturing memory; scheduler horizon accounts for resolved task IDs
semantics.receipts: task/policy-step/replay-sequence receipt persists in checkpoints and prevents duplicate completed-run consolidation
semantics.failures: partial optimizer or memory application blocks training/saving until complete native reload; a fully committed flush remains committed if later estimation rejects
semantics.tokenizer: temporary backend padding/truncation excluded from identity; vocabulary, template, added tokens and tokenizer sides stay pinned
semantics.missing_reference: loading a generation with no teacher clears stale reference state

boundaries: Every live native DDP peer enters the same task transition. Standard continual manager only. Generated tiny FP32 CPU model, real offline HF tokenizer and causal autograd loss. Serialized with training/global RNG consumers; external callback/environment state and lost processes remain outside the protocol.
